content.short: Junction is a swap and bridge aggregator routing trades across EVM chains, Solana and Hyperliquid.
content.description: Junction aggregates both swapping and bridging, covering EVM networks, Solana and Hyperliquid in one route search. Including a non-EVM chain in the same path is the harder part of this product, since the two sides settle under different assumptions about finality.
content.meta: Route a trade across EVM chains, Solana and Hyperliquid in one search.
